title: Counter Tariff Extract: Grace Hours and Late Figures on Equipment Rental and Demo Kit
content:
## Grace, daily late figure and replacement threshold

Three figures are held against each package of the Equipment Rental and Demo line for kit that stays out beyond the date written on the agreement: the whole hours after the time the kit is due back within which no late fee arises, the fee in USD for each calendar day the kit is out beyond its due date, and the number of calendar days beyond the due date after which the kit is treated as not coming back.

| Package | Grace, whole hours | Late fee, per calendar day | Days beyond the due date before the kit is treated as not coming back |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Junior Ski & Board Rental | 2 | 18.00 USD | 10 |
| Basic Ski & Board Rental | 2 | 28.00 USD | 10 |
| Sport Ski & Board Rental | 2 | 38.00 USD | 7 |
| Performance Ski & Board Rental | 1 | 52.00 USD | 5 |
| Demo Ski & Board Rental | 1 | 68.00 USD | 3 |
| Season-Long Lease Package | 24 | 38.00 USD | 21 |

### The columns defined

The grace figure is the whole hours after the time the kit is due back within which no late fee arises. The daily late figure is the fee in USD for each calendar day kit from the package is out beyond its due date. The last column is the number of calendar days beyond the due date after which kit is treated as not coming back.

### How the three move together

Grace narrows as the kit becomes dearer: 2 whole hours on the Junior, Basic and Sport packages, 1 whole hour on the Performance and Demo packages. The daily figure rises across the same run, from 18.00 USD on the Junior Ski & Board Rental to 68.00 USD on the Demo Ski & Board Rental, and the patience of the collective shortens with it, from 10 calendar days on the Junior and Basic packages to 3 on the Demo package.

The Season-Long Lease Package sits outside that pattern on all three columns. Its grace of 24 whole hours is wider than any day-hire package's, the widest of which is 2, and its 21 calendar days beyond the due date are more than any day-hire package's, the most of which is 10. Its daily figure of 38.00 USD is neither the highest nor the lowest of the line: it is the Sport Ski & Board Rental's figure over again, standing in the middle of the day-hire run of 18.00, 28.00, 38.00, 52.00 and 68.00 USD rather than at either end of it.

### Points of judgement on this extract

**A Performance agreement one whole hour past the time the kit was due back (hypothetical).** The grace figure held against the Performance Ski & Board Rental is 1 whole hour, so a whole hour has elapsed on that agreement and no further hour of grace stands against it.

**The dearest and the cheapest day.** A day of Demo Ski & Board Rental kit out beyond its due date carries 68.00 USD against it, and a day of Junior Ski & Board Rental kit 18.00 USD.
